concerns.asked: Discuss the predicted σ–π acoustic plasmon as an alternative assignment.
concerns.response: A paragraph on p. 3 argues the acoustic branch lies at lower energy for the probed geometry and momentum range, with details in Supplementary Section F; p. 2 states the conclusion.
concerns.judgment: The likely request was met with an explicit argument and supplementary analysis.
concerns.still_open: A stricter reader could want the RPA showing the acoustic mode overlaid on Fig. 4a in the main text.

concerns.asked: Show the shift is a momentum dispersion and not a geometry, polarization or matrix-element effect of rocking θin.
concerns.response: New σ/π polarization-resolved data from BESSY II at 2θ = 90° (Supp. Fig. S5; pp. 3-5), a Γ–M vs Γ–K statement (p. 3) and a momentum figure (Supp. Fig. S3).
concerns.judgment: The new data go the asked way and test the orbital part of the concern; the main text still gives no (q∥, q⊥) table or a dispersion re-measured at a second |q|.
concerns.still_open: Whether χ⁰ was computed along the real (q∥, q⊥) trajectory is still not stated.

concerns.asked: Reconcile the σ assignment from the BSE with the sizeable π weight in the Lindhard decomposition.
concerns.response: Fig. 4c is now read as σ intra-band at slightly lower and π at slightly higher energy, matching the measured dichroism (p. 4, Supp. Fig. S5).
concerns.judgment: The inconsistency is acknowledged and supported with new data.
concerns.still_open: The BSE projection in Fig. 2c still shows σ only.

concerns.asked: Fit the asymmetric feature appropriately and define the error bars.
concerns.response: Fits are now asymmetric Voigt (p. 3, Supp. Fig. S4) and the Fig. 3e error bars come from the fit covariance.
concerns.still_open: A model-based (χ-convolved) lineshape fit was not added.

concerns.asked: Show an incident-energy dependence to test whether the feature is Raman-like.
concerns.response: Supplementary Fig. S2 now shows the incident-energy dependence (p. 3).
concerns.judgment: The change goes the asked way, but the main text does not say what the map shows, so sufficiency cannot be judged.
concerns.still_open: No off-resonance or core-hole-off calculation is mentioned.

concerns.asked: Compare full spectra of data and theory and discuss the asymmetric lineshape and width.
concerns.response: Line cuts of RIXS, BSE and Lindhard added (Supp. Fig. S6, p. 4); a paragraph explains the BSE is less asymmetric and that linewidth grows with q as the continuum widens (pp. 3-4).
concerns.still_open: The 'closely except at smaller q' gap in Fig. 3e is still not quantified.

concerns.asked: Temper the claim that EELS cannot see the continuum and explain what makes MgB2 suitable.
concerns.response: The claim now holds 'as long as there is a separation in energy scales' (pp. 4-5); new Discussion paragraphs explain the favorable factors and the ultra-soft edge (p. 5).
concerns.judgment: The likely request was met in wording.
concerns.still_open: No material-specific loss-function estimate for MgB2 is given.

concerns.asked: Cite prior spectroscopy of particle-hole excitations and situate the novelty claim.
concerns.response: Refs 2-4 on inter-band and indirect intra-band observations, refs 26-31 on plasmons and the 3 eV peak were added (pp. 2-3).
concerns.judgment: Context improved, but 'remained experimentally elusive' and 'no feature ... reported' are kept unchanged.
concerns.still_open: The semiconductor light-scattering and IXS/EELS literature on simple metals is still not discussed.

concerns.asked: Describe the sample and show the result is reproducible.
concerns.response: Growth details (p. 5), TEY/TFY XAS and a second beamtime at BESSY II on presumably the same film type (p. 5).
concerns.judgment: Reproducibility is strengthened by a second facility; characterization is still thin.
concerns.still_open: No thickness, substrate, Tc or oxidation check is reported.

concerns.asked: Explain the higher-energy peak near 3 eV.
concerns.response: Assigned to a Landau-damped collective excitation seen before in IXS and optics (p. 3, refs 29-31).

concerns.asked: Make the data and code available.
concerns.response: Data deposited with a DOI; OCEAN, Quantum ESPRESSO and c_lindhard listed (p. 6).

concerns.asked: Clarify k-mesh and interaction parameters of the Lindhard/RPA calculations.
concerns.response: Methods state a 512×512×512 grid and U = 2 eVÅ calibrated against the 3 eV plasmon (p. 5).
concerns.judgment: The k-mesh ambiguity is resolved; the U units and weighting are not justified further.
concerns.still_open: The cross term in the orbital weighting and the U dependence are not discussed.
